case: GEFCom winsorize @928（暴露开发测试；outlier_iqr 正控隐藏）

programs.rationale: Winsorize is unsuitable in this context because its application coincided with a 0.09375 coverage loss, 20 new missing runs, and a maximum missing run of 18, while the seasonal residual worsened. A Hampel-based outlier replacement is a bounded alternative aimed at contamination without intentionally sacrificing coverage; its effect should be validated on the same decision window.

The failure indicates that winsorization damaged data availability and level/scale integrity (robust-center delta 10261.25 and scale delta 7116.85065). MAD-based outlier handling is a robust alternative for suppressing extreme contamination while better preserving the underlying level and seasonal structure; coverage and missing-run metrics should be checked after application.
